title: Bounded Drop-Walk State
statement: For a Boolean flag $s$ and a natural number $i$, define a state that is the $i$th walk state with flag $s$ when $i<2$ if $s$ is true or $i<4$ if $s$ is false; otherwise define it to be the seek state with flag $s$.
